author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

The SAFe **Product Manager,** Software leads the definition, prioritization, and execution of software and digital investments for an Agile Release Train (ART) in the **Power and Motion Business Portfolio** . You will be the primary connection between business strategy, customer and user needs, and software engineering execution, translating market opportunities and stakeholder requirements into actionable roadmaps, features, and release priorities. You will collaborate with commercial, product, architecture, engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and program leadership teams to guide investment decisions and ensure delivery of customer and business value.

You will report to the SAFe Team Lead and will work a hybrid schedule based in Pune, India.

  
  

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Develop and own the feature backlog and roadmap for software development according to portfolio priorities
* Manage alignment between Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), software architecture, and the Agile Release Train feature backlog
* Work with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to set implementation direction and balance priorities
* Coordinate with stakeholders outside the business segment on integration plans, dependencies, and release alignment with connected products and platforms
* Work with development teams to remove implementation barriers and coordinate resolution of technical, dependency, and delivery issues with the necessary stakeholders
* Guide the ART in achieving predictable, high-quality objectives by responding to issues, making timely decisions, and supporting release readiness
* Develop intuitive familiarity with the software portfolio, architecture, technology, R&D, customer workflows, and market factors to collaborate across technical and commercial teams
* Manage several simultaneous initiatives related to the effectiveness and flow of the Agile Release Train
* Support implementation of the global business unit product strategy and Annual Operating Plan
* Partner with Product Management to resolve complex internal and external customer problems with broad, long-term effects, responding with urgency and delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions
  

  

### **The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field
* Willing to travel up to 10%
  

  

### **The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience
* In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies and techniques, with experience supporting or leading an Agile Release Train
* Knowledge of industrial automation products and the software ecosystems that configure, connect, monitor, or support them
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation software, variable frequency drive, or motion product portfolios is highly desired
* Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, product management, software engineering, architecture, quality, and program teams
* Demonstrated success working within a global matrix environment to achieve multiple simultaneous goals
* Ability to communicate complex technical and business information clearly to multiple levels of stakeholders
* Understanding of business profit and loss responsibility
  

  

### **What We Offer:**

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programmes through OnTrack
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* Other local benefits

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-HR1

  
  
  

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Staff Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.  
  
**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**  
  
At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.  
  
***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**

As a Senior Staff Product Manager in the ITSM Product team, you will serve as a highly experienced individual contributor responsible for defining the product strategy for enterprise customer experiences across the Freshworks EX portfolio. In this role, you will tackle complex, cross-functional product challenges that span ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and adjacent products, driving enterprise adoption, trust and long-term customer success.

You will own the customer-facing strategy, roadmap and business outcomes for enterprise capabilities such as security, governance, compliance, enterprise administration and product-led growth. You will partner closely with the Enterprise Readiness, Platform and AI teams, who own the underlying shared platform capabilities, to deliver differentiated enterprise outcomes.

**Impact You Will Create**

**Drive Enterprise Product Vision**

Define and champion the long-term product vision for enterprise customers spanning governance, security, compliance, enterprise administration and product-led growth across the EX portfolio.

**Deliver Enterprise Business Outcomes**

Shape differentiated enterprise outcomes that improve enterprise adoption, customer trust, deployment success and expansion while leveraging shared platform capabilities.

**Champion Enterprise Customers**

Serve as the voice of enterprise customers by partnering with strategic customers, Customer Success and Sales to identify emerging needs and influence the product roadmap.

**Influence Cross-Portfolio Strategy**

Drive alignment across ITSM, ITAM, ITOM, Enterprise Readiness, Platform and AI teams to deliver cohesive enterprise experiences and maximize customer value.

**Elevate Product Leadership**

Mentor Product Managers on enterprise product strategy, systems thinking and customer-centric product development while raising the bar for enterprise product management across the organization.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Product Strategy**

Lead the definition and execution of the product strategy for Enterprise Adoption & Trust across the EX portfolio, ensuring enterprise customer needs are translated into differentiated product experiences.

**Roadmap Ownership & Strategy**

Own the end-to-end roadmap for customer-facing enterprise capabilities including governance, security, compliance, enterprise administration and product-led growth while influencing adjacent product and platform roadmaps.

**Cross-functional Leadership**

Partner with Enterprise Readiness, Platform and AI teams to leverage shared platform capabilities while owning customer problems, product strategy, adoption and business outcomes.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

Work closely with strategic customers, Sales, Customer Success and Product Marketing to identify enterprise opportunities, validate solutions and influence long-term investment decisions.

**Strategic Influence**

Represent the enterprise portfolio in executive planning, drive alignment across multiple product organizations and influence cross-functional investment priorities without direct authority.

**Mentorship**

Coach Product Managers on enterprise product strategy, customer discovery and cross-functional leadership.

 **Qualifications**

**Skills**

**Product Strategy & Customer Insight**

* Expertise in defining long-term product strategy for enterprise SaaS products.
* Strong customer discovery, JTBD and strategic account engagement skills.
* Proven ability to translate complex enterprise customer needs into scalable product experiences.

**Execution & Domain Expertise**

* Deep understanding of enterprise software including security, governance, compliance, enterprise administration and product-led growth.
* Experience driving cross-product initiatives by influencing multiple product and platform teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer outcomes, business priorities and technical feasibility.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Exceptional stakeholder management and influence without authority.
* Strong executive communication and strategic planning capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, ambiguous initiatives spanning multiple organizations.
* Proven ability to mentor Product Managers and elevate product thinking across teams.

**Qualifications**

* 9–14+ years of progressive Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS.
* Proven track record of leading strategic, cross-functional product initiatives with organization-wide impact.
* Experience delivering enterprise capabilities spanning security, governance, compliance, enterprise administration or product adoption.
* Demonstrated success partnering with platform teams to build differentiated customer experiences while owning customer and business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline; MBA is a plus.
* Proven ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across Product, Engineering and GTM organizations.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

You will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

**Responsibilities:**

● Support the product roadmap and backlog for web and mobile platforms  
● Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories ● Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution  
● Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking  
● Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics  
● Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials  
● Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

**Required Skills and Traits:**

● Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field  
● 1–3 years of product experience in web and mobile app environments  
● Strong analytical skills and understanding of product metrics using Google Analytics  
● Experience with Zoho Sprints and familiarity with tools like JIRA, Figma, or Trello  
● Knowledge of project management and the complete product development lifecycle  
● Ability to lead ideation sessions and define clear user and business requirements  
● Good written and verbal communication skills  
● Experience working with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders  
● Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver product demos with clear understanding of functionality and user workflows

**Preferred Qualifications:**

● Prior involvement in consumer-facing digital platforms  
● Understanding of APIs, technical constraints, and platform differences  
● Experience working with cloud-based products or services is a plus  
● Certification in Product Management from recognized institutions (e.g., Airtribe, Product School, Hello PM or equivalent)

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your total experience in product maagement (except freelancing/part time roles) ?
* Are you currently residing or willing to relocate to Goa ?
* Are willing to work 6 days a week onsite (Goa) ?
* Please mention your current/last fixed CTC (in lacs per annum).
* Please mention your expected CTC (in lacs per annum).
* How soon can you join (please include your notice period and relocation time needed for joining) ?

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management

**General Summary:**

**Help shape the next generation of AI-powered mobile experiences.**

Qualcomm is seeking a **Staff Product Manager** within the Handset Business Unit to work at the intersection of **AI, software, silicon, and consumer experiences** . You will partner closely with customers to turn ambitious product ideas into compelling smartphone and personal AI experiences.

This is a highly customer-facing role for a product leader with **strong product intuition, AI fluency, and technical depth** . You will connect customer and consumer needs with Qualcomm’s hardware, software, and AI roadmaps, bring together teams across technology domains, and help shape the future of mobile computing.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

**Customer Product Leadership**

* Serve as the primary product management interface for assigned customers, developing a deep understanding of their product vision, architecture, requirements, and roadmap.
* Translate customer insights into product priorities and drive alignment across Qualcomm product, engineering, customer engineering, technical account management, and sales teams.

**Integrated Hardware and Software Strategy**

* Serve as the primary product management interface for the Handset Business Unit’s software strategy with assigned customers, connecting customer needs with Qualcomm’s software, AI, hardware, and technology roadmaps.
* Own integrated hardware and software roadmap communication and coordinate across technology product owners to deliver a coherent end-to-end strategy.

**System-Level Product Management**

* Develop a system-level understanding of smartphone and personal-device architectures across AI, camera, voice, audio, modem, graphics, software, and related technologies.
* Connect technology capabilities, dependencies, and trade-offs to the overall device architecture and consumer experience.

**AI and Product Strategy**

* Develop expertise in emerging consumer AI experiences and a strong point of view on what constitutes a compelling product experience.
* Translate customer, consumer, market, and technology insights into product, portfolio, and roadmap recommendations.

**Technology Ecosystem**

* Maintain a strong understanding of developments across AI/ML, software, infrastructure, and related ecosystem technologies.
* Evaluate internal and external capabilities against product requirements and contribute to build, partner, or buy decisions.

**Roadmap and Executive Communication**

* Communicate integrated product roadmaps and deliver strategic and technical presentations to customers, partners, internal stakeholders, and senior executives.
* Translate customer and market feedback into recommendations and drive cross-functional alignment on product priorities, dependencies, and decisions.

**Level of Responsibility**

* Works independently with little supervision, making significant-impact decisions in complex environments.
* Leads complex cross-functional initiatives and manages priorities across short- and long-term horizons.
* Communicates complex technical and strategic information to audiences with differing levels of expertise.
* Applies advanced analytical judgment and problem solving when information is incomplete or conflicting.
* Uses strong negotiation and influence skills to align customers, product teams, technology leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Exercises creativity and independent judgment to develop new approaches and solutions and influence key organizational decisions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related technical field.**
* **5+ years of Product Management or related work experience.**
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years of work experience: **Master’s degree = one year; Doctorate = two years.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **10+ years of Product Management or related technical work experience.**
* **Advanced degree (MS or MBA) in a technical or business discipline preferred.**
* Experience with smartphones, mobile platforms, consumer devices, AI products, semiconductors, or complex hardware/software systems.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML, on-device agentic systems, multimedia, and associated software technologies.
* Experience translating customer or consumer needs into product strategy and technology roadmaps.
* Broad technical fluency across hardware and software, with the ability to reason about end-to-end product experiences.
* Experience evaluating internal and external technology capabilities as part of product or platform decisions.
* Strong product judgment and intuition for compelling consumer experiences.
* High agency, with demonstrated ability to create structure from ambiguity and proactively drive solutions.
* Strong customer leadership, influence, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to spend significant time working directly with customers.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* 5+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Applicants** : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here . Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).

Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.

**To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies** : Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

Company: Curavea Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Department: Product Management

Designation: Product Manager

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager for our pharmaceutical business. The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing product strategies, managing product portfolios, supporting sales and marketing activities, and driving brand growth in the market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Brand Management

* Manage the company's pharmaceutical product portfolio.
* Develop brand strategies to increase product sales and market share.
* Plan and execute new product launches.
* Identify opportunities for existing product growth.

2. Market Research & Analysis

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Monitor competitor brands, pricing, products and promotional activities.
* Identify market trends and new business opportunities.
* Analyse product performance and sales reports.

3. Sales & Marketing Support

* Develop marketing strategies and promotional plans for pharmaceutical products.
* Prepare visual aids, product presentations, product literature and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with RSMs, DSMs and the sales team to improve product performance.
* Provide product knowledge and scientific training to the sales team.
* Develop strategies for doctor engagement and prescription generation.

4. New Product Development

* Identify potential molecules and therapeutic segments for new product launches.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams for product development and launch planning.
* Study product positioning, pricing and market potential.

5. Coordination & Reporting

* Work closely with the sales, marketing and management teams.
* Track monthly product-wise sales and brand performance.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve sales and brand visibility.

Required Qualifications

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Life Sciences).
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and product management.

Experience

* 3–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in pharmaceutical product management or brand management preferred.
* Experience in handling product portfolios, marketing strategies and sales team coordination.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Market research and analytical skills.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical products and therapeutic segments.
* Strategic thinking and planning.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Product-wise sales growth.
* New product launch performance.
* Market share and brand growth.
* Promotional strategy effectiveness.
* Sales team product knowledge and training.
* Achievement of product-wise business targets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
2Base Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a Kochi-based IT services and software development company established in 2010. We are a full-service technology partner offering technology consulting, custom software development, enterprise application development, web and mobile application development, and digital transformation solutions. We have delivered across Insurance, EdTech, Hospitality, and Travel & Tourism, and we work with clients in global markets including the US and UK.

The Opportunity

We are building our own technology products, with a strong focus on AI-driven solutions, and we are looking for the person who will own what they become. This is a product at the concept and early development stage. You will shape its direction, validate the market opportunity, decide what is built and what is not, and drive it towards commercial success.  
As our first dedicated Product Management professional, you will also establish the product function at 2Base: there is no existing roadmap, process or product organisation to inherit.

Key Responsibilities

Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and long-term direction, and keep the roadmap stable enough to plan against and open enough to change when the evidence changes.  
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer discovery to identify and validate product opportunities, and bring the findings into roadmap decisions rather than filing them as reports.  
Translate customer problems and business needs into clear product requirements: the outcome and the user problem, specified well enough for Engineering to build against without dictating the solution.  
Own feature prioritisation and release decisions with Engineering and UI/UX, and be able to state the cost and the benefit of each choice. A roadmap that only says yes is a backlog.  
Identify and evaluate AI, Generative AI and automation opportunities, and assess each on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value before it reaches the roadmap.  
Define product success metrics before the work starts, instrument the product to measure them, and read the results honestly afterwards.  
Contribute to product positioning, pricing, go-to-market strategy and commercial viability, working with Sales and Marketing.  
Build shared context across the organisation so that teams can make decisions without routing every question through you.  
Work closely with the Founder, Engineering, UI/UX, Sales and other stakeholders to align on product direction and drive execution.

What You Will Not Own  
​  
Product Manager and Project Manager are used interchangeably across the market. At 2Base, they are different roles, so the boundary is stated rather than assumed.  
Client project delivery. Project Managers own client engagements, schedules, and escalations.  
Engineering architecture and implementation. You own what and why; Engineering owns how. Where the two conflict, you negotiate rather than instruct.  
UI/UX design execution. The design function designs. You own the user outcome and brief, review and decide against it.  
Final product investment and budget approval. The Founder decides what the product is funded to do and over what horizon. You own the case that decision is taken on.  
Client-specific commercial negotiations. Pricing and packaging of the product itself is yours; client contracts are not.

Requirements  
Experience

6–12 years in the technology industry, with at least 4 years in Product Management or direct product ownership.  
At least one product you took from concept or early development to actual customer usage, with a clear view of what happened after release. A product you inherited fully formed and maintained is a weaker signal than a smaller one you shaped.  
A decision not to build something, and what it cost you to hold that line.  
Direct work with engineering teams through a build, not across a handover, with enough understanding of software development, technical feasibility, APIs, integrations and cloud applications to judge what a decision will cost.  
AI and Emerging Technology  
Practical exposure to AI-powered products, Generative AI, machine learning or automation-driven solutions.  
The ability to tell a capability apart from a product, and to assess an AI use case on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value rather than on novelty.  
Product Judgement

You can describe how you decided what to build: the evidence you had, the evidence you wanted and did not have, and what you did about the gap.  
You can reason about a product commercially. Who pays, what for, and what has to be true for the numbers to work.  
You can hold a position with a founder, an engineering lead or a client, and change it when the argument against you is the better one. Knowing which situation you are in is the skill.  
You write and present clearly. Most of a product manager's influence here travels as writing, and a requirement that is ambiguous on Monday becomes an argument three weeks later.  
Ways of Working  
You start by asking rather than deciding. The first months are spent understanding users, the business model, what has already been attempted, and how decisions are actually made here.  
You work independently and establish your own processes. There is no research function and no analyst to brief.  
You influence without formal authority. Nobody in this structure reports to you, and the roadmap holds because people agree with it.  
You can make a decision that leaves someone unhappy, explain the reasoning, and keep working with them. Trade-offs are the job, and somebody loses every time one is made.  
Education

A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

What We Are Not Looking For  
Stated now rather than at the end of a multi-stage process.  
Project or delivery managers looking to change title. The skills overlap less than the market suggests, and this is not a promotion path from delivery.  
Business analysts who have written specifications against requirements someone else set. Valuable work; different work.  
Candidates whose account of a product is the features it shipped, with no view on whether it should have shipped them.  
Anyone who needs an established research function, design system and process in place before they can start.

Benefits  
A growth-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Global Payment Services (GPS), GPS INM Product team as Product Manager – Receivables.

**Job Introduction**

Manage the GPS INM receivables portfolio, encompassing UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect and structured B2B reconciliation products, including DART, ARR and third-party offerings. The role covers the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept, development and enhancement to launch, maintenance and commercialisation. Working under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager, coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver seamless client onboarding, effective collection and reconciliation solutions, robust supporting processes, sound product governance and a consistent client experience.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage the development, enhancement, launch, maintenance and ongoing performance of UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect, DART, ARR and other structured B2B and third-party reconciliation offerings.
* Translate client needs and business requirements into defined product designs, prioritised enhancements and actionable launch plans. Use market insights, competitor benchmarking and client feedback from Sales, Coverage and GPS teams to develop differentiated propositions, maintain a prioritised backlog and incorporate client validation and pilot feedback.
* Evaluate partnerships with acquiring providers, payment platforms and reconciliation solution providers. Coordinate IT, Operations, Client Management, GPS teams and external partners to deliver integrated client collection and reconciliation propositions, with clear ownership, agreed actions and appropriate partner due diligence and governance.
* Define and maintain end-to-end operating and service models covering client onboarding, production service continuity, collections, reconciliation, exception handling and ongoing servicing. Work with Operations and Client Management to document and agree workflows and resolve exceptions within agreed service timelines.
* Coordinate product deployments, enhancements, testing and launch readiness, with documented requirements and stakeholder approvals. Deliver assigned initiatives against agreed milestones and provide concise updates on priorities, progress, risks and decisions, escalating delivery dependencies promptly to the Senior Product Manager.
* Support commercialisation and client adoption through product collateral, sales enablement and ongoing enhancements. Partner with GPS and Coverage teams to convert client opportunities into suitable receivables solutions, tracking progress against agreed plans, product adoption and client usage.
* Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory guidelines and HSBC policies, internal controls and the Group Compliance Policy. Identify product, third-party and operational risks with risk stewards, coordinate controls and approvals, track mitigating actions and report losses appropriately. Support third-party assessments, regulatory reporting and client-issue resolution; monitor relevant collection, reconciliation and applicable partner chargeback/refund metrics; submit credit-risk exceptions and pricing decisions for approval; and ensure timely implementation of audit actions and resolution of regulator-raised issues.

**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, or equivalent, with a university degree and/or relevant training qualifications.
* Demonstrated progressive experience and a proven track record in cash management, receivables and/or payments product development and management, or equivalent relevant experience, including product development, project management, fintech engagement and market- or client-facing banking functions.
* Corporate transaction banking or cash management experience is preferred, but not mandatory. Experience in merchant acquiring, UPI collections, NACH, Virtual Accounts or structured B2B reconciliation is preferred, but not mandatory; familiarity with DART, ARR or third-party reconciliation offerings is beneficial.
* Demonstrated project and programme management experience, including co-creating solutions with IT and internal business partners. Excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and deliver within tight deadlines.
* Ability to develop innovative, flexible solutions addressing client needs and to understand clients’ business models, operating needs and core business fundamentals. Sound business acumen and commercial awareness, including relevant economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory considerations.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective internal and external relationships. A collaborative approach to teamwork, supported by self-motivation and a proactive working style.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to develop well-founded recommendations for decision-making. Familiarity with emerging technologies is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear, compelling presentations. Fluency in English is expected; additional language skills are beneficial.

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**

**Additional Notes:**

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: Product Manager
job_description:
This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* **Product roadmap:** Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* **New feature development:** Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* **Backlog prioritisation:** Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.
* **Enterprise workflow optimisation:** Understanding end-to-end dispute resolution workflows — from case initiation, notice generation and service, document management, hearings and arbitrator workflows to award generation, closure, billing, and reporting — and continuously improving them.
* **Customer-facing product management:** Working directly with customers, understanding their requirements, managing expectations, communicating feature releases, and handling difficult conversations around timelines, scope, and prioritisation.
* **Product documentation:** Writing clear PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and release notes that engineering and implementation teams can execute against.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Working closely with engineering leads, design, legal operations, implementation, business development, and customer success to take features from requirement to production.
* **Product analytics:** Using product usage, operational metrics, customer feedback, and workflow data to identify friction, measure adoption, and make informed product decisions.
* **Competitive positioning:** Tracking the legal-tech, ODR, BFSI technology, and enterprise SaaS landscape to identify product gaps, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to differentiate Webnyay.

You'll work directly with the leadership team and have significant ownership over product decisions and execution.

How We Work: AI-Native by Default

This is important enough to call out clearly: **we expect our Product Managers to use AI across the entire product lifecycle.** AI is not a separate workstream or an occasional productivity tool. It should be embedded in how you research, think, design, document, build, and ship.

That Means

* **Discovery:** Synthesising customer interviews, analysing support tickets and change requests at scale, researching legal and regulatory requirements, and gathering competitive intelligence using AI tools.
* **Definition:** Drafting PRDs, generating user stories, mapping workflows, identifying dependencies, and stress-testing edge cases before handing requirements to engineering.
* **Design:** Creating wireframes, prototyping interfaces, exploring UI variants, and validating user flows using tools such as Figma AI, v0, Lovable, or Claude.
* **Build:** Translating requirements into technical specifications, understanding APIs and system architecture, debugging alongside engineers, and using AI to review code and understand implementation trade-offs.
* **Launch:** Generating release notes, preparing customer communications, creating product documentation, and enabling sales and implementation teams with feature updates.
* **Measure:** Querying product data, analysing adoption and turnaround times, identifying workflow bottlenecks, generating hypotheses, and using AI to accelerate product analysis.
* **Automate:** Identifying repetitive workflows across product, operations, and customer delivery that can be simplified or automated using AI agents and integrations.

We don't expect you to be an engineer. We do expect you to be technically curious, resourceful, and capable of using modern AI tools to move faster and produce better work.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, legal-tech, or workflow automation.
* Experience owning an existing product and driving its roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business and customer requirements into structured product specifications.
* Experience working with engineering teams and understanding technical trade-offs, APIs, integrations, and software architecture.
* Excellent written communication. You should be able to write a clear PRD, explain a complex workflow, and communicate a product decision without ambiguity.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to prioritise opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and demanding enterprise customers without losing sight of the product roadmap.
* A bias towards execution. You should be someone who takes ownership, follows through, and gets things shipped.
* Genuine interest in AI tools and a willingness to experiment with them as part of your everyday workflow.

**An added advantage:** Experience with legal workflows, arbitration, mediation, BFSI, lending, collections, grievance redressal, regulatory technology, or high-volume transaction platforms.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager-Senior Product Specialist
job_description:
**Product Management**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

**About the Role**

Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.

This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next

* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness

* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact

* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders

* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale

* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized

* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving

* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows

* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering

priorities.

* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and

learning behavior.

* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.

* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.

* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.

* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.

* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.

* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and

post-launch monitoring.

* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.

* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.

* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).

* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.

* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning

them into product decisions.

* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.

* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.

* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.

* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.

* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.

* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding

platform-specific nuances.

* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.

* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.

* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).

* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on

student performance.

* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led

growth.

* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or

personalization/recommendations.

* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage

environments.

* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.

* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.

* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.

* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.

* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.

* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Job Introduction**

Tekion is expanding its platform into security and compliance products for automotive retail, and we are hiring a senior product professional to own this new product area end to end. This role will build across two connected domains:

* **Compliance / GRC:** Products that help dealerships meet regulatory obligations, including F&I deal compliance, privacy and data governance, and evolving federal and state requirements, directly within the systems they already use.

* **Cybersecurity:** A modular suite of security capabilities delivered as independent products over time, including vulnerability and network scanning, continuous exposure management, endpoint detection and response, email security, credential-exposure monitoring, data-loss prevention, and log analytics / SIEM.

This is both a zero-to-one and scaling mandate. The role will define strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach, turning validated customer demand into shippable, monetizable products. The role requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

What You’ll Own

* Product strategy for Tekion’s security and compliance product lines, including the vision, boundaries, and how the two domains reinforce one another.

* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.

* Packaging and pricing models, including subscriptions, consumption-based models, entitlements, and bundling.

* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.

* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Strategy

* Own the holistic vision, roadmap, strategy, and launch plan for Automotive Security Cloud across security and compliance workstreams.

* Conduct market and competitive research to identify customer needs, product opportunities, market size, and differentiation.

* Define product positioning, messaging, and business rationale for new security and compliance offerings.

* Build alignment across product, engineering, security, compliance, GTM, legal, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements & Analysis

* Run continuous customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized, well-specified product requirements.

* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch requirements; partner with engineering on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.

* Track relevant regulatory requirements, including GLBA Safeguards, FTC rules, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR, and translate obligations into product capabilities.

* Assess feasibility, risks, dependencies, costs, infrastructure needs, and resource requirements for proposed capabilities.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization

* Define the product/SKU catalog, entitlements, packaging, and pricing models for individual offerings and bundles.

* Build business cases and revenue models for new products, including subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU approaches.

* Recruit and manage design partners, run pilots, and convert validated pilots into referenceable customers and GA launches.

* Represent the product area to executives, sales, customers, and partners; support enablement, launch planning, and market entry.

* Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, retention, revenue, and risk reduction, and ensure products are instrumented to measure outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead collaboration across technical teams working on areas such as email security, vulnerability management, continuous testing, detection, compliance, and platform integration.

* Maintain alignment with leadership stakeholders on product progress, roadmap decisions, customer feedback, and market dynamics.

* Make independent product decisions with strong ownership, accountability, and clear communication.

* Set and communicate a multi-quarter vision and roadmap with measurable outcomes.

Must-Have Qualifications

* 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning security, compliance/GRC, infrastructure, platform, or B2B SaaS products.

* Strong product management fundamentals, including discovery, roadmap definition, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating business goals into executable requirements.

* Domain knowledge in at least one of the following: US automotive retail, dealership operations, F&I, DMS/CRM ecosystems, cybersecurity, GRC/privacy tooling, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability/exposure management, or DLP.

* Demonstrated experience taking a zero-to-one product to market or scaling an existing product line.

* Working knowledge of security architectures, threat models, security controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.

* Experience with subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU packaging and pricing for B2B SaaS products.

* Proven ability to work autonomously, make decisions independently, and drive products from concept through launch.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into clear product decisions.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfortable working with US-based teams and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

* Experience selling into or building products for regulated SMB or mid-market verticals.

* Familiarity with building on a platform or system of record such as DMS, CRM, or ERP.

* Experience productizing an internal capability into a customer-facing offering.

* Familiarity with ISO standards, SOC 2, dealership compliance, privacy regulations, and broader security governance needs.

* Hands-on exposure to security product categories such as vulnerability scanners, continuous penetration testing platforms, email security, threat detection, endpoint security, cloud security, or SIEM/log analytics.

* Experience evaluating build, buy, or partner decisions based on technical feasibility, cost, time-to-market, integration effort, vendor maturity, and long-term differentiation.

* Track record launching greenfield products, entering new markets, or operating in early-stage or 0-to-1 environments.

* Experience with pricing strategy, cost analysis, revenue modeling, or budget planning for security or compliance products.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*
