title: Senior Product Manager - Fully Remote Job
job_description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

title: Technical Product Manager - Lab Automation and Healthcare Solutions / Workflow Consultant
job_description:
**Job Requirements**  

To promote Lab Automation solutions and improve the productivity and efficiency of laboratory operations in the public and private sectors and facilitate transitional and change management processes for sites converting to a Siemens solution by creating lean laboratory automation designs, transition management processes and implementation expertise, ensuring customer satisfaction and quality throughout the design, implementation and optimization process.

**Product Management (Marketing) components of Role**

**Sales**

* Support the sales team by becoming involved in the sales process (Blue Sheets, tenders, customer visits).
* Provide relevant scientific, technical information and performing Automation demonstrations / presentations where required.
* Participate in all aspects of new product launches.

**Marketing**

Spend time in the field understanding market, developing key opinion leaders, coaching sales force in, and validating effectiveness of key messages

**Product Management**

Assist in the Development and implementation of effective launch plans, key messages, promotional materials, advertising and sales support material for the specified product portfolio (including the effective management of product for promotion and case studies) and consistent with Global Marketing directions.

Stewardship of customer issues with the Global Siemens organization to drive resolution for or understanding of the technical needs of Indian market.

**HCS/ Workflow Components of Role**

As a HCS to effectively satisfy the customer's needs for the optimization of laboratory automation solutions and processes using Siemens proprietary optimization tools and external analytical programs. Ensure any identified defects are followed up internally with the service and applications support teams and lead the team in completing the optimization of the solution using lean methodologies. To occur 6 monthly at all automation sites (or more/less frequently as per customer contract requirements)

Provide laboratory consultative services to current and potential customers to aid in the design of complex laboratory automation solutions. Produce technical CAD drawings (focusing on automation design and services requirements - electrical, pneumatic, water, waste, etc) for complete laboratory solutions and work with project management for costings and implementation planning. Provide detailed transitional processes as part of the solution offering

Maintain personal knowledge of LEAN operational procedures and participate in training courses including classroom attendance, 'self learning', computer based and 'on the job' training.

Education & Work Experience:

* Tertiary qualification in Science, Applied Science or related field.
* 15+ Years relevant experience.
* Product Management experience beneficial

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**[ WHO WE ARE]**

Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.

KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.

The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties that include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.

With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years and has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as Product Manager, define and manage the **roadmap** for India-facing features, collaboration events, and engagement loops.
* Write clear **PRDs**, set success metrics, and make data-driven product decisions.
* Act as **feature producer**: plan sprints, track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery.
* Lead **live-ops execution**, including events, content updates, reward systems, and real-time issue handling.
* Drive **user growth, onboarding, retention**, and monetization improvements for the Indian market.
* Collaborate with central teams, external partners, and marketing on feature launches and IP tie-ups.
* Analyze player data and market trends to optimize features and event performance.

**Qualification**

* 5 years in mobile gaming product management or production.
* Strong understanding of F2P systems, live-ops, and mobile game KPIs.
* Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, QA, and data.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

What you get in return

* Learn Best-in-class global product practices, and scope for fast growth
* Ability to learn from teams across the globe
* Open and transparent work culture with ownership
* Work on India’s biggest game of the decade.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Understands Analytics, Product Development, Producer Scrums very well, (AI part will be taught on the job)
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Leader / Product Manager -SDS2
job_description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel
* Other structural steel detailing / fabrication systems

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

* SolidWorks
* Autodesk Inventor
* Creo
* CATIA
* Bentley engineering products
* Other CAD/CAM/CAE, BIM, PLM, or fabrication software

  
**Additional Information**

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

We are partnering with you to find your next team member. To maximize the value of our upcoming intake session, we will use our AI tools to draft a clear, Sabre-branded job description before we meet. To do this, we need your **input below** —please complete the required fields with the **most relevant and accurate details** , and we will follow up with a full JD tailored to your needs.
  
**Preparing the Job Description**  
By defining the **core requirements** and **key advantages** of the role early, our talent acquisition team will translate your inputs into a polished draft to attract top talent.
  
**Please update the designated sections directly in the fields below before submitting your requisition.**-
  
**1. Role Overview**  
Provide a concise summary of three to four sentences detailing the core mission of the team and how this position aligns with our business strategy.

**As part of the Sabre Payments team, this Senior Product Manager will lead the definition, execution, and delivery of strategic payment initiatives critical to scaling Sabre’s global business. Operating at the core intersection of travel and modern financial technology, the role bridges commercial strategy and technical engineering to build robust, scalable payment capabilities. The successful candidate will resolve complex product challenges creatively to deliver high-impact solutions for our project teams, broader department, and travel partners. In doing so, this position directly advances Sabre’s overarching strategic vision of powering next-generation travel retailing and seamless transaction workflows worldwide.**

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**  
Detail three to five key areas of ownership. Focus on high-level deliverables, business outcomes, and strategic impact rather than routine administrative tasks.

* **Product Strategy & Requirement Translation:** Serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, translating high-level business goals into actionable functional specifications, technical requirements, and detailed user stories.
* **End-to-End Delivery & Execution:** Own and drive the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle across cross-functional engineering and design teams, ensuring features are delivered on schedule and directly impact the success of the project team, department, and clients.
* **Creative Problem-Solving & Technical Alignment:** Resolve a wide range of complex product and integration challenges through creative, scalable technical solutions, maintaining high quality and operational reliability.
* **Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Networking:** Proactively network and collaborate with senior internal teams (engineering, architecture, commercial) and external partners/vendors within your domain of expertise to align priorities and clear project roadmaps.
* **Team Guidance & Best Practices:** Act as a fully qualified domain practitioner, mentoring junior product associates or team members on product management best practices, backlog grooming, and Agile methodologies where applicable.

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**  
List three to five essential qualifications required to succeed in this role. Focus on technical skills, years of relevant experience, and critical capabilities.

* **Relevant Experience:** 5 years of dedicated product management experience partnering directly with engineering teams to define, build, and deliver customer-facing or platform products and capabilities.
* **Technical & Analytical Acumen:** Strong experience decomposing complex workflows into clear user stories, API/technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and roadmap milestones within Agile/Scrum environments.
* **Proven Delivery & Creative Problem Solving:** Demonstrated track record of independently resolving multifaceted product challenges in creative ways to drive measurable project and business outcomes.
* **Stakeholder & Influence Skills:** Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to network, build alignment, and present effectively across both senior technical leadership and commercial stakeholders.
* **Domain Knowledge (Preferred):** Prior domain experience in digital payments, fintech gateways/processing, or the travel technology ecosystem is a strong plus

  

**4. Why Join Us**  
Outline the key benefits of this opportunity as part of your team, including career development, team culture, and the unique aspects of the role that will attract top talent.

* **Lead at the Intersection of Travel & Fintech:** Directly contribute to architecting and scaling a high-growth travel fintech ecosystem that processes transactions across the global travel marketplace.
* **Innovation & Cutting-Edge Tech:** Join Sabre at the forefront of AI-driven transformation, leveraging modern platforms and intelligent automation to reshape how the world travels and transacts.
* **Autonomous Impact & Visibility:** Step into a "fully qualified" L10 role with meaningful ownership over strategic initiatives, where your solutions have a direct line of sight to client success and departmental growth.
* **Collaborative Culture & Growth:** Work within a collaborative, globally distributed team that champions knowledge sharing, continuous mentorship, and clear pathways for senior product leadership advancement.

  

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

  

The People Technology Foundation Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Foundation portfolio, ensuring that core workforce data, employee lifecycle capabilities, organisational structures and supporting technologies are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.

  

Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function. You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers across a portfolio initially comprising SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include capabilities such as Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.

  

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Foundation portfolio, ensuring it delivers measurable business value today while evolving to meet future organisational needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the People Technology Foundation product strategy, roadmap, backlog and priorities, ensuring investment and delivery remain aligned to business objectives and long-term technology direction.
* Act as the accountable owner for the Foundation portfolio, including SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation capabilities.
* Balance immediate operational priorities with quarterly objectives, 12-18 month roadmap commitments and longer-term capability evolution, ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable value today while supporting future organisational needs.
* Lead and develop the Foundation product team, providing direction, coaching, prioritisation and performance management while building product, platform and delivery capability across the Foundation domain.
* Partner with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead and participate in intake, demand and prioritisation processes, assessing Foundation-related incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and project requests.
* Own delivery outcomes across the Foundation portfolio, determining the most appropriate delivery approach through internal capability, blended delivery teams and partner-led delivery models.
* Define expected benefits, success measures and business outcomes, monitoring value realisation to ensure technology investment delivers measurable benefit.
* Own the Foundation product data model, configuration, business rules and information structures, ensuring workforce data structures support business processes, reporting, compliance, workforce planning and future capability requirements.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders, balancing local requirements with global standards, strategic priorities and product direction.
* Lead and develop the Foundation People Technology Community, creating structured engagement, feedback, knowledge-sharing and adoption mechanisms across regions and stakeholder groups.
* Drive adoption of leading practices across the Foundation portfolio, continuously assessing technology developments, market trends and industry approaches to improve product performance, user experience and business value.
* Monitor product health, service performance, adoption, usability and operational effectiveness, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and optimisation.
* Remain accountable for the quality, completeness and maintenance of Foundation product documentation, ensuring governance, audit, support and operational requirements are met.
* Own product relationships with support and delivery partners, reviewing commitments and outcomes, challenging recommendations where appropriate and driving effective knowledge transfer to build internal capability.
* Partner with architecture, security, data and integration teams to ensure solutions remain sustainable, compliant and aligned to enterprise standards and future technology direction.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including product ownership, roadmap planning, capability development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities for enterprise technology products.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, systems or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Experience translating business requirements, operational challenges and strategic objectives into product outcomes and measurable value.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, organisational structures, employee lifecycle processes and Foundation capabilities.
* Experience managing product demand, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience working with business stakeholders, regional teams, technology teams and third-party suppliers to deliver business outcomes.
* Experience managing partner-delivered services and balancing delivery through internal teams, blended teams and external providers.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing governance, product processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy and roadmap planning.
* Experience using product performance, service performance, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continuous improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable:**

  

* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise business application portfolios.
* Experience supporting OpenText or enterprise document and records management solutions.
* Experience supporting Time Off, Absence Management or Workforce Administration capabilities.
* Experience supporting Payroll technologies, payroll integrations or payroll-related HR processes.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, user groups, super-user networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience with application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management or service governance.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.
  

**Qualifications & Certifications - Desirable**

**Product**

  

* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Certification
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications, particularly Employee Central Payroll, Time Management, Platform Foundations or Position Management.
  

**Product & Delivery**

* SAFe Product Manager / Product Owner
* AgilePM
* Scrum Product Owner
* Scrum Master

**Service Management**

job_description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Product TPM team operates at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery, enabling the successful development and rollout of scalable, customer-centric solutions. At the Consultant (P03) level, the team is composed of Technical Product Managers who own feature-level delivery while collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
  
The team functions within an Agile framework, ensuring continuous delivery of high-quality product increments through iterative development, sprint cycles, and regular feedback loops. Each TPM is responsible for managing specific product modules or features, contributing to the broader product roadmap while aligning execution with organizational goals and customer needs.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The Consultant (P03) – Technical Product Management (TPM) role is responsible for driving the end-to-end delivery of technology-enabled product features by effectively bridging business requirements with engineering execution. The role combines product ownership, technical understanding, and Agile delivery to ensure the development of scalable, high-quality solutions aligned with customer needs and organizational priorities.

At this level, the TPM owns feature-level execution, collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, and contributes to product strategy and roadmap under guidance from senior product leaders.
  
  
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Ownership**

* Own and manage assigned product features or modules from concept to delivery
* Define detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain the product backlog
* Prioritize deliverables based on business value, customer impact, and feasibility

**2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Support**

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and execution
* Align feature development with overall product vision and business objectives
* Incorporate stakeholder input, user feedback, and analytics insights

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
* Work closely with engineering teams on solution design and implementation
* Assess technical trade-offs, dependencies, and constraints
* Ensure adherence to scalability, security, and performance standards

**4. Agile Delivery Execution**

* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retrospectives)
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of product increments
* Support continuous improvement in development and delivery processes

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and UX/design teams
* Act as the primary point of contact for owned features
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively

**6. Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and track KPIs for product features
* Use product analytics and user insights to drive improvements
* Optimize product performance, usability, and adoption

**7. Product Lifecycle Support**

* Support the full product lifecycle including requirement gathering, development, testing, and release
* Assist in documentation, training, and user adoption initiatives

Ensure smooth rollout and continuous enhancement of features

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

The ideal candidate should have 5–8 years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management, or software/program delivery roles, with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle and Agile methodologies. They should possess solid knowledge of SDLC, ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, and familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with Agile certifications (CSPO/CSM) considered an added advantage.

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

  
  

TransUnion Job Title

  
  
  
Consultant, Product Management

job_description:
**Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain**

**Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting**

**About the Role**

**The Team**

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

**Position Summary**

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Work You'll Do**

* **Presales & opportunity shaping:** Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

* **Business problem definition & success criteria:** Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

* **Domain-to-build translation:** Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

* **Use case discovery beyond the original ask:** Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

* **Stakeholder alignment & adoption:** Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

* **Value realization & measurement:** Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

* **Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets:** Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

* 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

* Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

* Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

* Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

**Core Competencies**

* Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

* Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

* Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

* Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

* Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

* Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

* Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

* Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

* Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

* Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

* Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

* Executive presence and client-facing credibility to lead business conversations with senior stakeholders while working fluidly with engineering and product teams in the same engagement

* Ability to build trust and durable working relationships quickly with client stakeholders and account teams in predominantly virtual and distributed delivery environments

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop client-facing materials and business cases, lead discovery workshops, and work effectively across distributed teams and international time zones

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Work You'll Do**

* **Presales & opportunity shaping:** Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

* **Business problem definition & success criteria:** Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

* **Domain-to-build translation:** Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

* **Use case discovery beyond the original ask:** Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

* **Stakeholder alignment & adoption:** Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

* **Value realization & measurement:** Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

* **Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets:** Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

* 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

* Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

* Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

* Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

**Core Competencies**

* Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

* Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

* Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

* Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

* Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

* Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

* Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

* Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

* Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

* Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

* Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

* Executive presence and client-facing credibility to lead business conversations with senior stakeholders while working fluidly with engineering and product teams in the same engagement

* Ability to build trust and durable working relationships quickly with client stakeholders and account teams in predominantly virtual and distributed delivery environments

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop client-facing materials and business cases, lead discovery workshops, and work effectively across distributed teams and international time zones

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

job_description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Sr. Product Manager on the Strategic Partner Integration team, you will own a defined product area within Docusign’s strategic integrations. Your initial focus will be procurement integrations, connecting agreement workflows to source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes across systems like SAP and other major platforms. You will collaborate closely across customers, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and the broader Docusign ecosystem. In this role, you will lead integrations end-to-end—from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. As the portfolio evolves, your scope may expand to additional strategic partner and enterprise-system integrations.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Product Management.

**Responsibility**

* Own the roadmap and priorities for designated strategic partner integrations, translating customer, partner, market, and technical insights into clear requirements and measurable outcomes
* Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and requirements through design, development, launch, adoption, and post-launch iteration
* Conduct customer and partner discovery, synthesize feedback and technical requirements, and translate them into product narratives, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs
* Partner with strategic ISVs to align on integration use cases, product requirements, responsibilities, dependencies, delivery plans, and launch readiness
* Define seamless integration experiences across APIs, bidirectional data flows, embedded user experiences, data mapping and agentic workflows in partnership with Engineering and Design
* Lead one or more cross-functional product development teams, coordinating dependencies and keeping execution aligned to agreed scope, milestones, and quality expectations
* Contribute to the broader Docusign ecosystem strategy and roadmap by sharing customer insights, delivery learnings, and opportunities to improve repeatability across future integrations
* Collaborate with Business Development, Partner Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support on launch plans, field enablement, customer communications, and adoption programs
* Establish and monitor product success metrics such as integration activation, usage, workflow completion, partner and customer adoption, reliability, and time to value; use insights to prioritize improvements
* Communicate product direction, roadmap, progress, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, escalating material issues when needed
* Share product management practices and provide informal mentorship to less-experienced colleagues, without formal people-management responsibility

  
  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 10+ years of related product management experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 8+ years of related experience with a master’s degree; equivalent experience may be considered
* Experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for a feature area, platform capability, or product in enterprise SaaS, enterprise applications, or integration-focused products
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development from discovery and requirements through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Experience working directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand problems, define requirements, make trade-offs, and deliver products that solve meaningful business needs
* Technical fluency and the ability to engage effectively with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, integration patterns, data models, authentication, event-driven workflows, and embedded experiences
* Hands-on experience with building AI agents, skills and/or MCP tools and integrating with leading AI platforms
Experience working in an Agile product development environment with globally distributed teams  

**Preferred**

* Experience building or managing integrations with procurement, ERP, CRM, CLM, or other systems of record; experience with platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Oracle, or Salesforce a big plus.
* Domain knowledge in procurement, source-to-pay, procure-to-pay, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, or agreement workflows]
* Experience defining partner-facing products, integration applications, APIs, developer experiences, or embedded workflows
* Experience working with external technology partners to align priorities, coordinate delivery plans, and support joint launches
* Experience sharing product practices, mentoring peers, or serving as a product resource in a matrixed organization
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and business concepts to partners, customers, cross-functional teams, and executives
* Strong analytical orientation, with experience using product and business data to make prioritization decisions and improve adoption
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**AI in Our Hiring Process**
  
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

job_description:
**Job Title: Project / Product Manager**

**Location:** Gandhinagar (GNR) – Work From Office (WFO)

**Shift / Working Hours:** General Shift

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Company Overview**

Sarder Inc. is a global family of innovative companies united by a bold vision — to educate and certify over one billion people worldwide. We are redefining lifelong learning through a diverse portfolio that spans corporate training, AI certifications, eLearning, proctoring solutions, and thought-leadership media.

Our ecosystem includes NetCom Learning, NetCom+, AI Certs, AI Labs 365, Adoptify AI, and Sarder TV, each contributing to our mission of shaping a future-ready workforce in an AI-driven world.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an organized Project / Product Manager to coordinate projects across internal teams and external partners. The role involves gathering requirements, preparing PRDs and user stories, managing project timelines, and ensuring smooth communication between stakeholders. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to track progress, manage integrations, and ensure timely project delivery.

**What You Will Do**

Gather and document requirements from internal and external stakeholders.

Prepare PRDs and user stories for engineering teams.

Manage backlog grooming and support sprint planning using Agile/Scrum.

Coordinate partner and API integrations with technical teams.

Track project progress, follow up on deliverables, and identify risks or blockers.

Plan and coordinate UAT with internal teams and external stakeholders.

Maintain documentation of requirements, decisions, and workflows.

Manage daily communication with internal teams, partners, and vendors.

Review analytics using Mixpanel or Google Analytics to support prioritization.

Review wireframes and design flows in Figma to ensure alignment with requirements.

Manage project tracking and reporting using Jira, Confluence, ClickUp, or Asana.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Functional Skills (Must Have)**

Good understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Experience in writing PRDs and user stories.

Knowledge of backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Experience in stakeholder and vendor management.

Strong requirement gathering and UAT coordination skills.

Good documentation and business analysis skills.

Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, ClickUp, or Asana.

Good knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

**Good to Have**

Basic understanding of REST APIs, Webhooks, and Postman.

Familiarity with Mixpanel and Google Analytics.

Basic knowledge of Figma, wireframes, and design flows.

**Candidate Profile**

A highly organized professional with strong communication, coordination, and documentation skills. Should be comfortable handling multiple stakeholders, gathering requirements, tracking project progress, and ensuring smooth execution without constant follow-ups or escalations.

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome.

2–4 years of relevant experience in Project Management, Product Management, or Business Analysis.
