author: Hiring Manager
title: Data Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**

Together with analytics team leaders you will support our business with excellent data models to uncover trends that can drive long-term business results.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Work in close partnership with the business leadership team to execute the analytics agenda
* Identify and incubate best-in-class external partners to drive delivery on strategic projects
* Develop custom models/algorithms to uncover signals/patterns and trends to drive long-term business performance
* Execute the business analytics program agenda using a methodical approach that conveys to stakeholders what business analytics will deliver

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Using data analysis to make recommendations to senior leaders
* Technical experience in roles in best-in-class analytics practices
* Experience deploying new analytical approaches in a complex and highly matrixed organization
* Savvy in usage of the analytics techniques to create business impacts

**IN THIS ROLE** — Lead end-to-end lifecycle ownership of one or more Data Products on Mondelēz's DBx-based enterprise data platform. Accountable for requirements, roadmap, design governance, delivery quality, operational oversight, and retirement execution. Combines strategic product ownership with hands-on analytical execution.

**WHAT THIS TEAM AND ROLE DOES** — Part of the MDS Data Products team driving AI-native transformation. Global data product strategy, delivery, and governance across the full lifecycle (demand intake discovery design build test deploy operate retire). Works at the intersection of business strategy, data governance, and technical delivery.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** — Experience bridging business and technical teams in data product delivery; passion for data governance and quality; strong stakeholder management across various stakeholders.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**:

* Own and maintain the data product roadmap.
* Facilitate data contracts with stakeholders.
* Engage with cross functional teams on demand prioritization and enterprise-level decisions.
* Lead requirements gathering, functional analysis, fit-gap assessments and scoping.
* Oversee design fitment, source discovery, and Source-to-Target Mapping (STTM).
* Approve initial designs, HLD, DIF documentation.
* Execute STTM mapping and document gap findings.
* Approve DQ validation, KPI acceptance, and release documentation.
* Prepare test cases, execute test scripts, and produce test evidence documentation.
* Coordinate UAT logistics - liaise with business stakeholders and document outcomes.
* Own UAT sign-off and Data Product assessments.
* Drive and own the Data Product Certification process.
* Prepare certification artefacts and supporting documentation.
* Own data product release and CAB documentation.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field.
* 5+ years in data product management, data analytics, or data engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of data lifecycle management (ingestion through retirement).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (GCP/BigQuery preferred).
* Hands-on experience with STTM mapping, DQ validation, and data quality frameworks.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, metadata management, and data contracts.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**GOOD TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Experience with DBT, Airflow/Composer, or similar data pipeline tools.
* Knowledge of FAIR data principles and data certification frameworks
* Background in FMCG/CPG industry data environments.
* Familiarity with data catalog tools (Collibra, Alation, Dataplex).
* Understanding of canonical data modeling and enterprise data standards.
* Experience with Jira and ADO.

No Relocation support available

**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------

### **At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.**

### **We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as** ***Oreo*****,** ***belVita*** **and** ***LU*** **biscuits;** ***Cadbury Dairy Milk*****,** ***Milka*** **and** ***Toblerone*** **chocolate;** ***Sour Patch Kids*** **candy and** ***Trident*** **gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.**

### **Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more** **than 80 countries** **and we sell our products in** **over 150 countries** **around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.**

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Job Type**
------------

RegularAnalytics & ModellingAnalytics & Data Science

**Product Manager – Capital Gains Account Scheme (CGAS)**

  

Business Unit (PA): Government & Institutional Business

Team: Government & Institutional Business

Reports to: Product Lead – Govt Agency Business & GIB Wholesale Synergy

Location: Mumbai

Job Function: Product

Role Type: Individual Contributor

Direct Reports: Nil

Travel: Low

Band: E4/D1

Version: 1.0

  

**Job Purpose**

Own end-to-end CGAS product management across Account A (Savings) and Account B (Term Deposit).

Ensure compliance with Income Tax provisions and CGAS rules while driving operational governance, portfolio growth and customer experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Development & Maintenance

Maintain CGAS product constructs, eligibility, validations and restrictions.

Drive product/system changes with Technology and Operations.

Update product/process documentation for regulatory changes.

Portfolio Management

Analyse market potential, competition and target segments.

Drive deposit growth through focused initiatives and customer education.

Monitor inflows, withdrawals, redeposits, utilization timelines and closures.

Publish portfolio MIS and leadership insights.

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

Train branches/teams on CGAS and improve sourcing effectiveness.

Develop customer communication and product collateral.

Conduct customer engagement, events/webinars and track marketing effectiveness.

Customer Service

Manage CGAS escalations and supervisory complaints.

Guide branches on eligibility, documentation and processing.

Capture feedback and drive product/process improvements.

Compliance & Regulatory

Ensure adherence to CGAS rules, reinvestment conditions, timelines and documentation.

Govern withdrawals, redeposits, utilization controls and deceased claims.

Coordinate with Operations/Compliance and liaise with MoF/CBDT for guidelines and approvals.

Implement regulatory changes across channels.

Portal & Data Management

Maintain AskNow/internal communication channels.

Coordinate with BIU for accurate MIS and portal updates.

**Educational Qualifications**

Graduate/Post-Graduate in Business, Finance, Economics or related field; MBA mentioned in the JD.

**Key Skills**

CGAS and capital-gains exemption knowledge

Banking operations, KYC and documentation

CRMNext/Flexcube familiarity

Analytical and problem-solving skills

Stakeholder management and customer orientation

**Experience Required**

3–5 years in Product Management, Government Business or Liability Products.

**Major Stakeholders**

Operations, Branch Banking, BSG, Audit, Compliance/RRD, Legal, Digital/BSG and Marketing.

Refer to the Job Description

-------------------

HDFC Bank is one of India’s leading private banks. This was done as part of RBI’s policy for liberalization of the Indian banking industry in 1994. HDFC Bank was incorporated in August 1994 in the name of HDFC Bank Limited, with its registered office in Mumbai, India. The bank commenced operations as a Scheduled Commercial Bank in January 1995. title: Product Owner/Product Delivery - Senior Associate
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark shaping global reference data capabilities in a team committed to Diversity, Inclusion & Opportunity, career growth, and mobility.

As a Product Owner Associate in Client Account Services Change and Strategy within Commercial and Investment Bank, you translate product strategy into clear business and technology outcomes. You partner with product management, technology, and operations stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery across the account and standing settlement instruction reference data ecosystem. You apply analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and agile execution to deliver measurable business value, stronger controls, improved efficiency, and an enhanced client experience.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Product Managers to support execution of the product roadmap and strategic priorities.
* Define business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Prioritize the product backlog by balancing business value, client needs, risk considerations, and technical dependencies.
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable delivery outcomes for technology teams.
* Serve as the primary liaison between product management, technology, and operations throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive end-to-end delivery of product enhancements from concept through production implementation.
* Maintain a healthy backlog and ensure delivery teams are prepared for upcoming sprints and releases.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance activities, operational readiness, training, and implementation planning.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders and senior management.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency using data-driven insights, automation, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Demonstrate experience in product ownership, business analysis, change management, or product delivery within financial services.
* Apply agile methodologies and product development practices to plan and deliver work.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective delivery.
* Manage a product backlog and support feature delivery across multiple stakeholders.
* Analyze business processes and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Influence stakeholders across product, technology, and operations organizations.
* Communicate effectively through concise written and verbal updates.
* Use Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office applications to support delivery execution.

**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Bring knowledge of markets products, prime brokerage, clearing, custody, or reference data operations.
* Demonstrate familiarity with account and standing settlement instruction reference data processes.
* Deliver experience supporting strategic data or reference data transformation initiatives.
* Use Structured Query Language, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytical tools.

**Open Position: AI Product Manager**  
**Location: Malad (West), Mumbai**  
**Experience: 4+ years**  
**Qualification: Bachelor’s degree**   
**Only candidates based in Mumbai Suburban locations (Dahisar to Dadar) should apply for the Position.**

**You can also contact on: 9372974661 / 8928772622 / 7021155918**  
**We are working 6 days, i.e., from Monday to Saturday.**

**Role Summary**

Drive the roadmap and execution of an AI-powered LMS while managing the product development team. Focus on building scalable, user-friendly solutions that improve adoption and learning outcomes across industries.

**Job Description**

* Define and execute product roadmap for AI-driven LMS/LXP
* Manage and align the product development team for timely delivery
* Build AI-powered features such as personalized learning, recommendations, and chatbot interfaces
* Own end-to-end product lifecycle from requirements to release
* Work closely with enterprise clients to gather requirements and tailor solutions
* Drive product customization to suit different industries and use cases
* Prepare effort estimates and scope for new modules, enhancements, and customizations
* Improve user adoption, engagement, and overall experience
* Drive integrations with HRMS, content platforms, and collaboration tools
* Track product performance using data and analytics

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in Product Management (SaaS preferred)
* Experience in LMS, LXP, or HR Tech is a plus
* Strong understanding of AI/ML use cases in products
* Exposure to authoring tools and content creation workflows
* Experience in managing product or cross-functional development teams
* Experience in effort estimation, scoping, and requirement analysis
* Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills

**Good to Have**

* Experience with enterprise clients across industries
* Exposure to chatbot or conversational AI products
* Understanding of learning ecosystems and competency frameworks

**Key KPIs for This Role**

* Release Efficiency: % of features delivered on time vs planned roadmap
* Time to Market: Average time taken from feature finalization to market launch
* Wireframing Effectiveness: Time taken to convert requirements into approved wireframes
* AI Feature Impact: Usage and effectiveness of AI-driven features
* Customization Turnaround: Time taken to scope and deliver client-specific enhancements
* User Engagement: Improvement in completion rates, repeat usage, and session frequency
* Customer Feedback: Reduction in escalations and improvement in satisfaction scores
* Integration Success: Number and stability of integrations delivered
* Team Productivity: Sprint velocity, backlog closure rate, and development cycle time

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Global Product Manager – Sustainable Seafood Certification (MSC/ASC)
job_description:
**Company Description**

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.

 **Job Description**

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Global Product Manager, MSC/ASC ensures that the certification services related to the MSC/ASC Chain of Custody and ASC Farm are successful and have long-term viability. The main responsibilities and purpose of this role are :

* To have overall responsibility for the successful management of the schemes ensuring the global operation is efficient and meets the expectations of SGS markets (affiliates), external clients, scheme owners and accreditation bodies.
* To ensure global internal and external KPIs are met, and all relevant approvals and accreditations are maintained to safeguard the SGS business and reputation.
* To provide overall commercial strategy and go-to-market (GTM) guidance for affiliates to facilitate product growth in key countries and regions.
* Digital mindset to track competitors' products, research and monitor market trends and to help improve the efficiency of the global MSC/ASC growth strategy.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITES**

**Operational:**

* To manage the Global MSC/ASC team in multiple locations effectively to ensure the team remains competent, motivated and efficient.
* Maintain full knowledge and understanding of SGS IT systems, procedures and external approval criteria to conduct audit report reviews and allow efficient management of technical review and certification decision process.
* Develop relevant internal and external KPIs and monitor them to facilitate decision-making and drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure all relevant accreditations and approvals are adhered to, to safeguard the SGS business and brand reputation.
* Manage the launch of new MSC/ASC schemes and revisions.
* Manage the costs and expenses of department effectively to contribute to the overall achievement of the department’s P&L targets.
* Carry out performance review appraisals for team and lead recruitment activity as necessary.

**Technical:**

* Act as the MSC/ASC technical expert for the global network and effectively convey key messages to stakeholders at all levels within the network demonstrating pragmatism whilst maintaining the integrity of the scheme.
* To achieve and maintain all required accreditations for MSC/ASC and maintain an accurate and up to date knowledge of the product regulatory evolution.
* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with the MSC/ASC Scheme technical management
* Communicate and interact effectively with other Product Managers for globally managed food schemes to evaluate opportunities for development and synergies.
* Actively participate in relevant scheme owner committees or working groups to ensure SGS maintains influence and exposure in the area.

**Commercial:**

* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior leadership of MSC/ASC.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the Global Food Team, International Sales and Global Key Account Managers as needed.
* In line with the segment strategy, provide business plan for the growth of the product in key countries and regions.
* Alignment with Marketing function in the development of the relevant specific marketing materials to support business growth.
* Contribute to the achievement of the overall objectives of the Food Assurance business.

**General:**

* At all times, behave in accordance with the Company’s Code of Integrity & Professional Conduct.
* At all times, adopt a safe behavior by exercising due regard for the health and safety of employees and clients, in line with policies and procedures.
* This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements, but a general description of the job.

**The role reports to the Global Food Certification Manager**

 **Qualifications**

**PROFILE**

* Extensive knowledge and experience of the MSC/ASC Seafood Certification certification business and relevant regulations.
* Ability to combine technical credibility with relationship management and commercial awareness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Excellent understanding of food Aquaculture and quality systems in a certification and auditing context.
* Background from Certified Body is a must have.
* Digital mindset with experience of compliance, food safety and regulatory intelligence platforms.
* Pragmatic, with proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong team leadership and people management skills.
* Business / commercial acumen to support go-to-market (GTM) strategies.
* Pragmatic with ability to think outside the box.
* Excellent verbal, presentation and technical writing skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to build trusted relationships at all levels within and outside the organization.
* Attention to detail with ability to multi-task effectively, work under pressure.
* Ability to manage conflicting priorities across multiple countries or projects.
* Fluent in the English language.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
* Experience with Copilot 365 and/or similar AI‑powered productivity and decision‑support tools.

**DESIRABLE SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Lead auditor level (including the required food processing industry experience) qualification in specific product.
* People management and managing or working with remote teams.
* Extensive audit experience includes commercial proposal preparation (including extensive experience in multi-site proposals and Integrated Audit proposals).
* Responsibility for maintaining accreditation against ISO 17065.
* Work experience within a large multinational company and managing communication within a large network.

**Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we welcome candidates based across Europe or India who have a valid right to work in their country of residence. Please apply with your CV in English.**

 **Additional Information**

**Why SGS?**

* Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
* Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model.
* SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
* Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
* Benefits platform.

**Join Us:** At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

* Digital mindset to track competitors' products, research and monitor market trends and to help improve the efficiency of the global MSC/ASC growth strategy.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITES**

**Operational:**

* To manage the Global MSC/ASC team in multiple locations effectively to ensure the team remains competent, motivated and efficient.
* Maintain full knowledge and understanding of SGS IT systems, procedures and external approval criteria to conduct audit report reviews and allow efficient management of technical review and certification decision process.
* Develop relevant internal and external KPIs and monitor them to facilitate decision-making and drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure all relevant accreditations and approvals are adhered to, to safeguard the SGS business and brand reputation.
* Manage the launch of new MSC/ASC schemes and revisions.
* Manage the costs and expenses of department effectively to contribute to the overall achievement of the department’s P&L targets.
* Carry out performance review appraisals for team and lead recruitment activity as necessary.

**Technical:**

* Act as the MSC/ASC technical expert for the global network and effectively convey key messages to stakeholders at all levels within the network demonstrating pragmatism whilst maintaining the integrity of the scheme.
* To achieve and maintain all required accreditations for MSC/ASC and maintain an accurate and up to date knowledge of the product regulatory evolution.
* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with the MSC/ASC Scheme technical management
* Communicate and interact effectively with other Product Managers for globally managed food schemes to evaluate opportunities for development and synergies.
* Actively participate in relevant scheme owner committees or working groups to ensure SGS maintains influence and exposure in the area.

**Commercial:**

* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior leadership of MSC/ASC.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the Global Food Team, International Sales and Global Key Account Managers as needed.
* In line with the segment strategy, provide business plan for the growth of the product in key countries and regions.
* Alignment with Marketing function in the development of the relevant specific marketing materials to support business growth.
* Contribute to the achievement of the overall objectives of the Food Assurance business.

**General:**

* At all times, behave in accordance with the Company’s Code of Integrity & Professional Conduct.
* At all times, adopt a safe behavior by exercising due regard for the health and safety of employees and clients, in line with policies and procedures.
* This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements, but a general description of the job.

**The role reports to the Global Food Certification Manager**

 **Qualifications**

**PROFILE**

* Extensive knowledge and experience of the MSC/ASC Seafood Certification certification business and relevant regulations.
* Ability to combine technical credibility with relationship management and commercial awareness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Excellent understanding of food Aquaculture and quality systems in a certification and auditing context.
* Background from Certified Body is a must have.
* Digital mindset with experience of compliance, food safety and regulatory intelligence platforms.
* Pragmatic, with proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong team leadership and people management skills.
* Business / commercial acumen to support go-to-market (GTM) strategies.
* Pragmatic with ability to think outside the box.
* Excellent verbal, presentation and technical writing skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to build trusted relationships at all levels within and outside the organization.
* Attention to detail with ability to multi-task effectively, work under pressure.
* Ability to manage conflicting priorities across multiple countries or projects.
* Fluent in the English language.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
* Experience with Copilot 365 and/or similar AI‑powered productivity and decision‑support tools.

**DESIRABLE SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Lead auditor level (including the required food processing industry experience) qualification in specific product.
* People management and managing or working with remote teams.
* Extensive audit experience includes commercial proposal preparation (including extensive experience in multi-site proposals and Integrated Audit proposals).
* Responsibility for maintaining accreditation against ISO 17065.
* Work experience within a large multinational company and managing communication within a large network.

**Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we welcome candidates based across Europe or India who have a valid right to work in their country of residence. Please apply with your CV in English.**

 **Additional Information**

**Why SGS?**

* Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
* Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model.
* SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
* Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
* Benefits platform.

**Join Us:** At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**

Take Ownership: Own and build modules for sustained differentiation and growth. Develop deep domain expertise and understand trends in the market. The role requires you to plan, build, release, and measure success for an end to end modules.

Be a Customer Champion: Develop a sense of empathy with our customer base to build an understanding of various problems. The role is also a bridge between the customer and the engineering teams to ensure focus on solving customer needs & delivering continuous value. Practice Craftsmanship: Learn and Practice product craft. Create solutions with delightful user experiences and find the balance between solving the customer problem and shipping the right product solution. We take pride in releasing the smallest of features while iterating and shipping regularly.

Play as One Team: The role needs you to communicate clearly to various stakeholders of Product development, Engineering, Marketing, Sales & Leadership teams and work together to bring your vision to life.

Act with Urgency: Breakdown complex problems to phases to help the team make incremental progress while still keeping the bigger picture intact. You’d evangelize the vision and ensure maximum customer value is achieved with the appropriate amount of work.

 **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of working in global/cross-functional software teams in a software product company. SaaS experience is preferred as you’d settle right in.
* Experience in building SaaS products is a plus
* Being empathetic and having a strong listening ability to understand the other person - may it be a customer or a stakeholder.
* Ability to arrive at intuitive & uncomplicated solutions from concept to scale by leveraging AI.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts/customer problems in a simple way to internal & external stakeholders.
* A track record of making day-to-day data-driven decisions in a fast-evolving environment while keeping an eye on the overall vision.
* Having worked in a mode of structured experimentation - measuring and iterating on problems from time to time to achieve product goals.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Role Description:

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Product Manager in the Pay-in Payment Methods team, you’ll shape and grow payment experiences that help travellers pay in ways that work for them. You’ll lead the launch of alternative and local payment methods in priority markets, and use customer, partner and performance insights to improve our products across Booking.com’s business.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Chennai, TN

**About The Role:**

Condé Nast is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Trusted Data Products to help transform how data powers insights, innovation, and decision-making across our global portfolio of brands. As AI reshapes how businesses interact with data, we are evolving our data platform to make trusted information more accessible, actionable, and intelligent. This role will help build the foundations that allow teams to move beyond traditional reporting toward AI-powered analytics, conversational insights, and better business decisions.

You will own the evolution of key capabilities within our enterprise data platform, including curated data products, and AI-enabled analytics experiences such as conversational data exploration. Working with Data Engineering, Analytics, and business teams around the world, you will turn complex data into reliable, accessible products that help people answer questions, uncover opportunities, and act on insights.

This is a highly collaborative, technically focused product role that combines hands-on execution with forward-looking thinking. You will help shape how data is structured, connected, and delivered for both human and AI consumption, while keeping the platform reliable, scalable, and responsive to changing needs. Your work will directly influence how Condé Nast uses data and AI to understand audiences, evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and make more informed decisions.

  

**What You'll Do**

Enable BI and analytics platform evolution.

* Drive technical enhancements that support BI, insights enablement, and AI-powered data experiences, working with global stakeholders to align platform improvements with business needs.
* Partner with Analytics and business teams globally to identify recurring challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that improve data accessibility, self-service, and decision-making.
Manage engineering delivery, dependencies, release readiness, technical risks, and ongoing platform health; track measurable outcomes and communicate progress clearly.  

  

**Build trusted, AI-ready data products**

* Drive development of curated, business-ready Gold-layer data products that help teams move from fragmented reporting toward consistent, AI-powered insights and decision-making.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics, and Data Governance on data contracts, definitions, quality standards, lineage, documentation, certification, and monitoring.
Identify opportunities to enhance and manage existing data products, such as Identity Resolution and Single Customer View, in partnership with their stakeholders and owners.  

  

**Develop Conversational Analytics and AI capabilities.**

* Drive development and continuous improvement of conversational AI capabilities, including the curated datasets needed to support trusted natural-language analytics.
* Work with Analytics and Engineering to improve semantic definitions, metadata, context, and data readiness so AI-generated answers are accurate and useful.
Establish evaluation, testing, feedback, and monitoring practices for conversational data access; identify opportunities to expand conversational analytics, AI assistants, and other capabilities that make insights more accessible and actionable.  

  

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including significant work on data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or technical data products.
* Hands-on familiarity with Databricks and modern lakehouse architecture or comparable platforms is highly desirable; experience with Databricks Genie or comparable conversational analytics capabilities is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, pipelines, medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data quality, lineage, observability, and access controls.
* A track record of partnering closely with data engineers to deliver dependable platform capabilities, curated datasets, and technical improvements.
* Ability to turn broad goals into crisp requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and executable plans while exercising independent product judgment.
* Understanding of semantic and metrics layers, metadata, and the foundations needed for trustworthy AI-enabled analytics.
* Experience supporting BI and analytics tools and collaborating with analysts to solve recurring data-access and usability problems.
* Strong communication skills and experience working across global Engineering, Product, Analytics, and business teams.
* A systems mindset, curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, and a practical focus on platform reliability, adoption, and business value.
* Experience in media, publishing, advertising, subscriptions, or consumer data ecosystems is a plus.

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

job_description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

* Define and own licensing, entitlement & SKU structure for product and service sales and pricing.

* Own the customer portal and public APIs, including the customer user experience and interaction with our products and services through both the customer portal and public API usage.

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software on the fleet – from imaging and configuration, to release management and device upgrades, to fleet-wide monitoring and operations.

* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for appliance imaging & configuration, including build processes, manufacturer infrastructure deployment, fleet configuration & feature flag management, and zero-touch provisioning.

* Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.

* Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.

* Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.

* Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.

* Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.

* Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.

* Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and requirement documents, and support backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**

* 10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.

* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.

* Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.

* Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.  

  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================

title: Senior Product Owner - Service and Supervision (IVR)
job_description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**

The Omni IVR Product Owner will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering enhancements that improve the customer voice experience through natural language understanding, intelligent call routing, and contact center automation. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, operations, and vendor partners to translate customer and advisor needs into actionable product requirements, optimize call flows, reduce misroutes, improve containment, and ensure IVR capabilities align with service strategy, operational readiness, and measurable business outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to translate the Omni IVR roadmap into prioritized features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint-ready backlog items that support natural language, call routing, and service experience objectives.
* Own day-to-day Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, story prioritization, dependency management, sprint planning support, requirement clarification, and coordination with delivery teams to ensure roadmap commitments are executed successfully.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, operations, technology, UX, analytics, and vendor partners to gather requirements, validate call flow changes, support testing, resolve defects, and drive continuous improvement across IVR routing, containment, and caller experience.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 7–8 years of experience working with voice systems, IVR platforms, contact center technologies, or related customer service technology solutions.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner or in a similar product delivery role, including backlog management, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and sprint execution support.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, demos, testing support, and production readiness activities.
* Ability to translate business needs, caller experience goals, and operational requirements into clear features, user stories, call flow changes, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, and vendor teams.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Advanced collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, UX, vendors, and business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead requirement discussions, clarify complex needs, manage competing priorities, and build alignment across diverse teams.
* Value-driven product ownership mindset, with the ability to balance client experience, operational efficiency, technical feasibility, roadmap priorities, and delivery commitments while acting with integrity and helping the team win together.

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience with natural language understanding, conversational IVR, speech recognition, text-to-speech, intent design, call routing logic, or voice bot capabilities.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, telephony technologies, CRM integrations, routing strategies, call flow design, or service center operations.
* Experience using data, reporting, or performance metrics such as containment, misroutes, transfer rates, call volume, average handle time, and customer experience trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools and documentation practices, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, or similar tools used for backlog management, process flows, and requirement traceability.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Technical Product Manager (TPM) for CareSelect Imaging is responsible for translating product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into clear, executable technical work and driving that work through successful delivery.

This role serves as a critical connection point between Product Management and Engineering, partnering closely with development teams in India and the U.S., as well as Architecture, QA, Operations, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The Senior TPM must be able to understand the intended business and customer outcome, translate that need into manageable technical capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain actively engaged through planning, development, testing, release, and post-release validation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined product execution. This individual does not need to be the solution architect or engineering lead, but must be technically fluent enough to understand system interactions, integrations, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and technical constraints; ask the right questions; challenge assumptions; and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

A key measure of success in this role is the ability to turn complex or sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-understood, appropriately scoped work that engineering teams can execute predictably.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate strategy into executable work: Partner with Product Management to translate business, customer, and product needs into well-defined capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized technical work
* Own backlog readiness and work decomposition: Break complex initiatives into manageable increments, maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, and ensure work is sufficiently defined and understood before entering development
* Partner closely with Engineering: Work day-to-day with onshore and offshore Engineering, Architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and dependencies, and resolve questions throughout development
* Drive delivery across teams: Support sprint and PI planning, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and proactively manage scope, risks, blockers, and decisions from initial definition through development and delivery
* Ensure quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA on testing, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and deployment activities, ensuring product changes meet intended business and customer outcomes
* Communicate and continuously improve: Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and release impacts while identifying opportunities to improve requirements quality, delivery predictability, and collaboration across distributed teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHI

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: BaNCS Product Manager
job_description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role purpose**

The Business Product Manager will act as the accountable business owner for the BaNCS platform within Entitlements and Trade & Settlements. The role is responsible for defining business strategy, prioritising product development, governing platform change, management of the application and all Data attributes, ensuring operational readiness and maximising business value from platform investments.

The role serves as the primary liaison between Operations, Product Management, Technology, vendors and business stakeholders while ensuring the platform supports strategic modernisation objectives, regulatory obligations, operational efficiency and client service requirements.

**Core responsibilities**

1. Product strategy and roadmap

* Own and maintain the multi-year BaNCS product roadmap.
* Define the platform vision, target state and measurable business outcomes.
* Prioritise demand, enhancements, regulatory change and strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate business cases, benefits, risks, dependencies and investment opportunities.
* Align regional and functional requirements to the enterprise settlements strategy.

2. Platform governance

* Act as Business Application Owner for BaNCS and provide clear business accountability.
* Chair or represent the business in product governance forums and working groups.
* Approve business requirements, operating-model decisions and solution designs within delegated authority.
* Maintain oversight of product risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions.
* Escalate strategic decisions, delivery risks and control concerns to the appropriate governance body.

3. Requirements and change management

* Gather, challenge, document and prioritise business requirements.
* Translate operational and client needs into clear capabilities, outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* Manage the business backlog and recommend release priorities.
* Review impact assessments, change requests, sequencing options and implementation plans.
* Ensure changes transition successfully into the operating environment.

4. Data and process ownership

* Own or coordinate ownership for the key business processes operating through BaNCS.
* Define data-accountability and stewardship arrangements for critical settlement data.
* Approve business data mappings, static-data requirements and interface requirements.
* Oversee data-quality issues, remediation priorities and governance upkeep.
* Ensure changes to data use are appropriately assessed and governed.

5. Testing and implementation

* Sponsor business testing and secure appropriate operational SME participation.
* Agree UAT scope, test priorities and business acceptance criteria.
* Oversee review of test cases, outcomes, defects and residual risks.
* Coordinate business sign-off for requirements, data, testing and implementation readiness.
* Support go-live, migration, stabilisation and post-implementation review activities.

6. Vendor and stakeholder management

* Act as the primary business contact across Operations, Product, Technology, change teams and TCS.
* Build alignment across legal entities, regions, processing teams and control functions.
* Manage vendor-related priorities, requirements, costs, dependencies and escalation paths.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Resolve competing priorities and facilitate timely business decisions.

7. Risk, regulatory and control

* Ensure platform design and change reflect applicable regulatory and operational-control requirements.
* Assess impacts arising from market, legal-entity, client and custody-model change.
* Support audit, risk, compliance, resilience and control assessments.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, access governance and maker-checker controls are reflected in the operating model.
* Maintain traceable approvals, decisions and governance evidence.

8. Financial and portfolio management

* Support annual capital planning and funding submissions for BaNCS initiatives.
* Develop or coordinate business cases with clear scope, outcomes, benefits, risks and resource needs.
* Prioritise investments against strategic, regulatory, risk and operational criteria.
* Track delivery against approved scope, funding and roadmap commitments.
* Monitor benefits realisation and recommend corrective action where expected value is at risk.

Experience :

For internal applications - 24 months as Senior Consultant

A College or University degree and/or data governance and quality work experience is required.  
10+ years experience in financial services  
Deep domain knowledge  
Strong cross business unit experience leading enterprise initiatives

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Digital Product Manager - API Management Platforms (Apigee & IBM DataPower)
job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

Role Overview  
  
We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to drive the strategy, roadmap, adoption, and lifecycle management of our enterprise API Management platforms, including Apigee and IBM DataPower. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of product management, API ecosystem, integration architecture, platform governance, and stakeholder management experience.  
  
This role will be responsible for defining the product vision, prioritizing platform capabilities, driving modernization initiatives, enabling development teams, and ensuring the platform delivers secure, scalable, and reliable API services across the enterprise.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for API Management platforms including Apigee and IBM DataPower.
* Partner with business, architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to identify platform needs and translate them into prioritized product features and capabilities.
* Drive API platform adoption across enterprise teams by promoting best practices, standards, and self-service capabilities.
* Manage product backlogs, feature prioritization, release planning, and stakeholder communications.
* Establish API governance, security, lifecycle management, and onboarding standards.
* Lead modernization initiatives involving API gateways, cloud-native architectures, AI-driven integrations, and developer experience enhancements.
* Work closely with engineering teams to define platform requirements related to scalability, resiliency, performance, observability, and operational excellence.
* Define and track platform KPIs, adoption metrics, API consumption trends, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Collaborate with vendor partners and internal leadership to evaluate emerging technologies and platform enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops, platform analytics, and operational insights.
* Support budgeting, capacity planning, and investment decisions related to API management platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 12+ years of experience in Product Management, API Management, Integration Platforms, or Enterprise Middleware technologies.
* Strong experience with **Apigee API Management** and **IBM DataPower Gateway** platforms.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise platform products and driving platform adoption at scale.
* Deep understanding of API design, REST services, API lifecycle management, developer portals, and API governance.
* Experience working in Agile product management environments with responsibility for roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.
* Strong understanding of API security concepts including OAuth, JWT, mTLS, OpenID Connect, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar tools.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
* Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with AI Gateway capabilities and GenAI platform integrations.
* Exposure to Kong, MuleSoft, Azure API Management, or other API gateway technologies.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Relevant certifications in Product Management, Cloud, Apigee, or Agile methodologies.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**
----------------------------

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence decisions across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strategic thinker with a customer-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale platform transformation initiatives.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Increased API platform adoption and developer satisfaction.
* Improved platform reliability, scalability, and security posture.
* Delivery of roadmap commitments aligned to business priorities.
* Reduction in API onboarding time and operational overhead.
* Enhanced observability, governance, and compliance across the API ecosystem.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Yateesh B Gybgaa@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

title: Senior Product Lead
job_description:
**Organization:**  
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.

**Job Title:** Senior Product Lead

**Location:** Bangalore

**Business & Team:**

As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.

You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.

**Impact & contribution:**

As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.

  

**Reporting lines:** Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.  

**Essential Skills:**

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams  

**Years of Experience:** 11+
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.

  

**Qualifications:** B.Tech

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

Advertising End Date: 29/11/2026

job_description:
**Jr. Product Manager**

**Company:** ModelsLab  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, Work From Office

About ModelsLab & MStudio.ai

ModelsLab is a technology company focused on building innovative AI and SaaS products.

Our flagship product, **MStudio.ai**, is an AI filmmaking platform that brings the entire creative filmmaking workflow into one place. From scriptwriting, character creation, image generation, video generation, and voice to timeline-based editing, MStudio.ai provides the tools needed to create films and visual content.

We are looking for a proactive Junior Product Manager to help us plan, manage, and improve our products.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand business requirements and convert them into product requirements.
* Manage product features, roadmaps, and development priorities.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, marketing, and other teams.
* Prepare product documentation, PRDs, feature specifications, and user stories.
* Track product development progress, deadlines, and milestones.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Collect user feedback and identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Coordinate product testing, bug tracking, and feature releases.
* Understand user journeys and improve MStudio.ai workflows.
* Monitor product performance and suggest new features.

Required Skills

* 1–2 years of experience in Product Management or a similar role.
* Understanding of SaaS products and software development.
* Familiarity with Agile methodology and product development lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Jira, Trello, Notion, or similar tools.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with different teams.

**Additional Advantage:** Experience working with AI products, creative tools, video platforms, or SaaS applications.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who takes ownership, thinks from the user's perspective, understands business requirements, and can turn ideas into actionable product improvements.

**Apply:** hr@modelslab.com

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
